set.body:
The JavaFX host (Interaction 12 review fixes, uncommitted on main 0f6a0a0 at filing) is now stricter than the browser widget at two boundaries. Decide whether SvgWidget should match; SvgWidget was deliberately not changed.

1. Pan history. In SvgWidget.requestWindow (modules/browser/js/src/main/scala/intaglio/browser/SvgWidget.scala ~947-953) every navigation frame, a pan drag included, goes through the same 400 ms rest timer, so a pan held still past the pause is recorded mid-drag and one drag becomes several undo entries (documented in docs/browser-widget.md:123). JavaFX records a pan drag as one entry from press to release (or Escape / focus loss).

2. Restored viewports. SvgWidget.restore (~237-242) resolves the snapshot and dispatches RestoreSnapshot with no check that the saved viewport can be drawn. JavaFX refuses, before committing, with SnapshotError.Invalid: a viewport on a plot that cannot navigate, a viewport for a panel the view does not have, or one normalizing to a single value; a viewport outside the bounds is drawn shifted inside and recorded as drawn.

Both differences are documented under "Differences from the browser widget" in docs/javafx-interaction.md. Shared trace parity (tools/trace) exercises neither case.

Acceptance: either align SvgWidget (with browser regression tests and re-recorded traces) or record the divergence as intended in both guides; remove the JavaFX differences section when aligned.
set.title: [Intaglio][Browser] Align SvgWidget pan history and restore viewport checks with the JavaFX host
